turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have about twenty minutes, Hale. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of class, and nobody called me first. Why?
Totally unrelated, but you're good with words.
Don't manage me, Hale. Answer the question about the zero.
I have to email a parent tonight about a fight in the cafeteria. Could you help me word it?
Write your own email, Hale. I'm here about Owen, and I'm not leaving until you tell me the zero is coming off.
Just a couple of sentences. You'd nail it.
No. I'm not here to write your emails, and you're spending my time on someone else's child. Who decided on Owen's zero?
